name: tool-mcp-oauth
title: MCP OAuth: log your MCP servers in with a browser, tokens kept by the app
description: OAuth logins for tool-mcp's servers (mcp.auth): `pikit tool-mcp-oauth login <server>` logs in on your machine (dynamic client registration with a client name you choose, PKCE) and uploads the login; one owner keeps it and refreshes each server's token once at a time, for every conversation.

tool-mcp-oauth.description: MCP servers' OAuth logins: tool-mcp-oauth login <server> [--port <n>] | status | logout <server> (any: --url <origin>)
